issues.title: '<cstdlib>' is included but only atoi uses it
issues.detail: src/parser.cpp:2:1: warning: include could be narrowed [misc-include-cleaner]

prose.title: Recursive descent over three precedence levels
prose.detail: expr handles + and -, term handles *, / and %, factor handles parentheses and numbers. Each level calls the next one down, so precedence falls out of the call structure rather than a table.

prose.title: expr: sums and differences
prose.detail: Folds term results left to right with + and -.

prose.title: term: products, quotients and remainders
prose.detail: Folds factor results left to right with *, / and %; a zero right-hand side of % throws std::domain_error.

prose.title: factor: a parenthesised expression or a number
prose.detail: Recurses into expr after an opening parenthesis, otherwise reads a number.

prose.title: number: a run of decimal digits
prose.detail: Consumes digits from the cursor and converts them.

prose.title: isDigit: an ASCII digit test
prose.detail: True for '0' to '9'. Locale-independent, unlike std::isdigit.

prose.title: printResult: the one output format
prose.detail: Prints "= value". Every front end should go through it.

prose.title: main: parse argv[1] and print it

review.title: term(): modulo by zero is not handled
review.detail: reviewer-a: resolved by the guard, keep / consistent.

review.title: Modulo by zero unchecked in term
review.detail: reviewer-b: guard rhs before %, and decide what / by zero does.

review.title: atoi swallows overflow
review.detail: Prefer std::stoi or from_chars so an overflowing literal is an error.
